title: Testing, Metrics, and Accessibility
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of CLI tests, coverage, signer review, and cultural/linguistic limits, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in sign-language-to-text-translation.
learning_objectives: Explain CLI tests, coverage, signer review, and cultural/linguistic limits in plain language and connect it to tests/test_cli.py; sign_language_translator/text/metrics.py.
Trace one input through the testing, metrics, and accessibility stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: CLI tests, coverage, signer review, and cultural/linguistic limits
practical_outcomes: Trace the testing, metrics, and accessibility stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for CLI tests, coverage, signer review, and cultural/linguistic limits.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
